issues.body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Turn on airplane mode
2. Launch FocusFlow 2.4.1
3. App crashes immediately

Logcat shows a NullPointerException in SyncManager.init() — it assumes network is available. Expected: app should start in offline mode and queue sync for later.

Device: Pixel 8, Android 15.
issues.title: Crash on startup when offline

issues.body: Every time I open the app with airplane mode enabled it force-closes. Started happening in 2.4.0. Please fix, I use this on flights all the time!

issues.body: Since 2.3.0, FocusFlow is the top battery consumer on my phone (18% overnight). Looks like the periodic sync worker runs every 15 minutes even when nothing changed. Suggest exponential backoff or only syncing on change.
